# Original Syslinux 6.03 test resources

These binaries and their detached RSA signatures were retrieved from the
original Rufus resource service at https://rufus.ie/files/syslinux-6.03/.
`provenance.json` records exact URLs, lengths and SHA-256 hashes. These are
compatibility fixtures; signature tests use Rufus's original fixed public key.
Syslinux is distributed under GPL version 2 or later; see COPYING.
Corresponding upstream release source:
https://www.kernel.org/pub/linux/utils/boot/syslinux/6.xx/syslinux-6.03.tar.xz
The application contains its existing pinned 4.07 and 6.04-pre1 templates.
